content_html:
How to Choose a Website Development Company in Patna

To choose a website development company in Patna, shortlist three agencies, open the live websites they have built on your phone, compare itemised quotes for the same scope, and confirm in writing that your business owns the domain, hosting and code. Also ask what happens after launch: who updates the site, fixes problems and answers your calls. A good partner explains things clearly, shows real local work and does not promise instant Google rankings.

What Patna businesses usually need

Many Patna businesses, from coaching institutes and clinics to shops, hotels and builders, need a site that loads fast on mobile data, shows up in local search and turns visitors into calls or WhatsApp messages. In addition, some need online admission forms, appointment booking or a small online store. Knowing your main goal makes it far easier to compare agencies.

Step-by-step: choosing an agency

  1. Write a one-page brief: goals, pages, features, budget and deadline.
  2. Shortlist three agencies from referrals, Google reviews and their own websites.
  3. Check live work, not screenshots; test speed and forms on a phone.
  4. Call two past clients and ask about deadlines and support.
  5. Compare itemised quotes for the same scope.
  6. Agree a written contract covering payments, timelines, revisions and ownership.

Questions to ask a website development company in Patna

  • Which platform will you use, such as WordPress or Shopify, and why?
  • Will the domain and hosting be registered in my business name?
  • How many design revisions are included?
  • Is basic SEO, such as titles, sitemap and Google Business Profile linking, included?
  • Who will maintain the site after launch, and at what monthly cost?
  • Can I edit text and photos myself?

Pricing in Patna

Type of siteTypical range
Simple business website₹10,000 – ₹40,000
Larger business site with SEO₹40,000 – ₹1.5 lakh
Ecommerce or custom features₹60,000 upwards

These are rough ranges; scope matters more than city. Our website development cost in Patna guide goes deeper.

Red flags

First, a very low price with no written scope. Next, the domain registered in the agency's name. Then, no live portfolio. After that, pirated or "nulled" themes, which often hide malware. Finally, promises of first-page rankings within weeks.

Local SEO matters

A Patna website should support local search: correct name, address and phone details, a linked Google Business Profile and pages for your main services. Google explains how local results work in its local ranking guide.

Web development in Patna: what good support looks like

Good web development in Patna does not end at launch. For example, a reliable web development agency in Patna should reply within a working day, fix bugs found in the first month at no extra cost and offer a simple maintenance plan. In addition, they should train you to update text and photos yourself. Before you hire a web developer in Patna, ask how they handle problems such as a hacked site or a failed update, and who you should call when it happens.
